title: M30 Champion Risk-Free Runner Expansion Test (45 Pips)
research_question: Does expanding the risk-free runner take profit (InpTP2Pips) from 30.0 to 45.0 pips increase total net profit and profit factor without increasing equity drawdown on GBPUSD M30?
hypothesis: Because the initial 50% partial close at TP1 (15.0 pips) moves the stop loss to Breakeven, the runner carries zero downside capital risk. Expanding InpTP2Pips from 30.0 to 45.0 pips will capture extended directional swings on M30, increasing expected payoff and total net profit while holding drawdown strictly within baseline boundaries (<= 2.5%).

facts: EXP-0022 on GBPUSD M30 with InpTP2Pips=30.0 achieved +$583.78 net profit, Profit Factor 3.68, and 2.07% max drawdown in training (2020-2024).
EXP-0023 on GBPUSD M30 achieved +$505.25 net profit, Profit Factor 1.49, and 3.88% max drawdown in validation (2025).
In both baseline experiments, all profitable trades reached TP1 (15 pips) and moved SL to BE, making the secondary position completely risk-free.
M30 directional trend runs on GBPUSD frequently extend 40-60 pips beyond key Fibonacci 50.0% and 61.8% levels.
inferences: Capping the runner at 30 pips prematurely truncates high-momentum trend runners.
If the trailing stop (8 pips) protects profits after TP1, widening TP2 to 45 pips gives larger runners room to yield higher payoffs before getting stopped out.
evidence: EXP-0022 total_trades=17, profit_factor=3.68, win_rate=82.35%, total_net_profit=583.78, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=2.07
EXP-0023 total_trades=59, profit_factor=1.49, win_rate=74.58%, total_net_profit=505.25, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=3.88

independent_variables.name: InpTP2Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Extend risk-free runner take profit from 30 to 45 pips to capture larger trend expansions.

assumptions: Breakeven trigger at TP1 successfully moves stop loss before any potential reversal.
Trailing stop of 8.0 pips locks in partial gains if market reverses between 30 and 45 pips.
expected_observations: Total net profit exceeds baseline EXP-0022 (+$583.78).
falsification_conditions: Total net profit decreases below EXP-0022 (+$583.78), indicating price frequently reverses to BE before hitting 45 pips.
